name: Amos Bridger
appearance: Lean, sun-weathered, greying hair, poorly trimmed mustache, pronounced limp in left leg; wide-brimmed hat with faded northern regimental badge.
portrayal: Soft-spoken, hospitable, slow to anger; rolls a copper piece between his fingers.
motivations: Preserve his family’s ranch and children’s livelihood.
personal_circumstances: Indebted to Four-Spur; fencing threatens access to water.
viewpoint_of_the_war: Former northern infantryman; believed rebellion justified, regrets its suffering.
war_consequences: Permanent leg injury; owes life to a royalist field surgeon.
viewpoint_of_the_frontier: Supports frontier independence and customary rights.
relationships: Cordial relations with Varkesh herders; respects Hester Mott, distrusts Hugh Maddox.
knowledge_and_rumors: Knows old livestock trails and a seldom-used crossing Four-Spur intends to enclose.
source_profile: Illustrative record example; not a canonical encounter.
source_reference: Accepted campaign record example developed after Handbook v0.4
